session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Small Pullback Bear Trend, Then Bull Trend Reversal'; filename extends it with the '2nd leg bull trap', 'small pullback bear trend' and 'late bull trend reversal after Final Bear Flag' phrasing. Reading: open 4135, early LL DB / HL DB support at 4099-4102 (blue/green notes, green dotted lines) lifting a parabolic bull wedge spike to 4160 that turned into a 2nd-leg bull trap; sell-off into an HH-DT-at-EMA / wedge retest at 4132 (red dotted line spans the morning), stacked LL DB / HL MTR signals at 4100 (both failed), then a small-pullback bear trend of shallow bear flags down to 4060 with drawn magenta wedges, an early-afternoon 'Final Bear Flag' range at 4062-4072 with a 'Wedge' bottom, and a strong late bull trend reversal to 4155 into the close. Axis prints 13:00 sideband then May 06:45 -> 13:00 with a 5/3 edge marker (offset-style again).
